canonical_2023_census_source.publication: Kenya Health Facility Census Report September 2023
canonical_2023_census_source.atlas_table_reference: Table 2: County Summary; Facilities Targeted Over Facilities Assessed, Closed & Denied Access

verified_capabilities: The public registry exposes facility-level records and supports county, constituency and ward administrative filters.
Public facility records expose constituency and ward labels alongside facility identity and operational metadata.
The registry is a live/current facility system and therefore is not automatically equivalent to the dated August-September 2023 Health Facility Census assessment universe.

IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-COUNT.reason: The canonical Atlas indicator is the dated 2023 Health Facility Census assessment count. Current KMHFR geography fields make child aggregation technically plausible, but a current registry count must not be substituted for the 2023 census assessment universe. A dated facility-level census extract or official child-level tabulation is required before materialization.

IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-DENSITY.reason: The canonical Atlas density is derived from the 2023 census-assessment numerator and a 2023 population denominator. Child-level publication requires a defensible dated facility numerator plus compatible constituency/ward population denominators and boundary-vintage reconciliation. County density must not be copied down or recomputed from a live registry against mismatched denominators.

IND-HEALTH-FACILITY-STOCK.reason: The live Ministry of Health KMHFR exposes facility records with constituency and ward fields, so an independently versioned current facility-stock series may be defensibly obtainable by direct official aggregation. It must remain distinct from the 2023 census-assessed count and must pass geography, status, duplicate and snapshot-date controls before publication.

source_semantics_hold.note: The Atlas P20 source file records a national 2023 facilities-assessed numerator of 14,883 from the report's county Table 2 counting rule, while the Ministry report executive summary describes 12,384 facilities as fully assessed. These may represent different census coverage concepts. No child-level derivation should proceed until the exact Table 2 numerator semantics are reconciled against the report. Existing county observations are not altered by this review tranche.

required_next_evidence: Reconcile the 14,883 Atlas Table 2 numerator with the report's 12,384 fully-assessed executive-summary figure and document the exact inclusion rule.
Locate an official dated 2023 facility-level census extract or official constituency/ward tabulation for the census-assessment indicators.
For a live KMHFR facility-stock series, capture a reproducible registry snapshot and verify operational-status, duplicate, moved-facility and administrative-geography rules.
Reconcile all constituency and ward labels/codes to the Atlas 290-constituency and 1,450-ward registries, retaining explicit spatial holds for unmatched or ambiguous records.
For density, obtain compatible child-level population denominators for the same reference period and boundary vintage before computing any rate.
Reconcile any proposed child aggregation back to the governing county totals where the source universe and period are intended to match.
